title: acer dasycarpum f. lutescens
intro: Acer dasycarpum f. lutescens, commonly known as the Lutescent Paperbark Maple, is a plant species in the Sapindaceae family. It is primarily known for its use in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Acer dasycarpum f. lutescens include modulating the immune system and exhibiting antimicrobial properties, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
